benefits.text: Helps lashes look curled, longer and fuller.

howToUse.text:
Apply directly to lashes from root to tip. 
Can be repeated to build volume as desired.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

sellingPoints.text: Helps lashes look curled, longer and fuller; can be reapplied to build volume; long-wearing formula according to brand materials.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it actually lengthens/thickens lashes. “Long-wearing” should not be interpreted as absolutely waterproof/smudge-proof under all conditions.

positioning.text: A mascara that helps lashes look curled, longer and fuller, suited to creating defined, intense and striking lashes.

finish.text: Deep black lashes / long and full / striking.

positioning.text: A mascara that helps lashes look curled, longer and fuller, in a chestnut brown that is softer than black.

finish.text: Defined brown lashes / long and full / softer than black.
